scope_note: Project title, recipient, final delivery scope and client acceptance must be confirmed before sign-off. Client feedback below was reported by the team in conversation on 23 October; the original meeting date/minutes have not been verified. Team proposals are newly documented requirements, not historical client commitments.

stories.title: Select and inspect a topology
stories.story: As a network researcher, I want to choose a topology in the web interface so that I can inspect the network used for my next evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: The chosen topology updates the displayed devices, links and associated fault list.
The map selector and benchmark form remain synchronized.
The interface states whether automatic evaluation, manual execution or catalog exploration is supported.
tests: dashboard_delivery.cjs: topology selection refreshes faults and disables unadapted benchmark

stories.title: Select a compatible fault
stories.story: As a network researcher, I want to select an applicable fault for the chosen topology so that the evaluation uses the intended failure mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Only the selected topology's catalog is displayed; unsupported combinations are rejected by the server.
Fault descriptions and targets are available to the operator.
Healthy controls perform no injection, and ticket variants are not counted as different physical mechanisms.
tests: dashboard_delivery.cjs: healthy control cannot be manually injected

stories.title: Run the selected benchmark workflow
stories.story: As a network researcher, I want to select a topology, fault and agent model and start the benchmark from the web page so that I can evaluate the intended configuration without issuing manual fault commands.
acceptance_criteria: The submitted topology, fault group, model, repetitions and evaluation settings reach the existing runner unchanged.
For an adapted environment the runner performs baseline, injection, diagnosis, scoring, result saving and recovery.
An unadapted topology cannot accidentally execute against EnterpriseTopology.
A current model-backed end-to-end run is required to verify agent execution; a MOCK browser run alone does not satisfy that condition.
tests: dashboard_delivery.cjs: selected topology/fault reaches the benchmark and its report

stories.title: Measure a useful level of diagnostic difficulty
stories.story: As a benchmark stakeholder, I want agent diagnostic accuracy to be approximately 50% to 70% under a declared reference configuration so that the benchmark has useful discriminatory difficulty.
acceptance_criteria: Report the reference model/version, fixed case manifest/hash, scoring version, prompt, tools, turn budget, seed, repetitions and denominator.
Working primary metric: exact RCA correct / all attempted scheduled diagnoses; report scored-only accuracy, errors and full correctness separately. Confirm this metric choice with the client.
Report actual accuracy even outside 50% to 70%; never clamp scores, remove failures or change the test set after seeing final results.
The target remains empirically unverified until applicable model results are reviewed; no model benchmark was rerun for this report.

stories.title: Use reproducible validated fault scenarios
stories.story: As a benchmark maintainer, I want each supported scenario to define its baseline, injection, observable impact, ground truth and recovery so that repeated evaluations begin and end in a known state.
acceptance_criteria: Verify a healthy precondition before mutation and the actual fault state after injection.
Check the expected service impact and an unaffected control path; redundancy does not imply every failure must cause an outage.
Verify repair predicates and the complete baseline before clearing owned pending faults.
Record repeat runs as repeatability evidence without treating one repeat as a reliability guarantee.

stories.title: Produce trustworthy diagnosis scores
stories.story: As a researcher, I want diagnosis scoring to follow an explicit ground-truth contract so that correct, partial, incorrect and unscored answers are distinguished consistently.
acceptance_criteria: Detection, device, resource, fault type and exact RCA are distinct metrics.
Exact RCA requires every expected cause and rejects incorrect or duplicate additional causes.
Missing quality judgement remains unknown; a correct label alone does not prove explanation or repair quality.
The same result file is counted only once; errors remain visible in denominators.

stories.title: Evaluate misleading reports and healthy controls
stories.story: As a researcher, I want accurate, vague and misleading tickets plus healthy controls so that the benchmark can distinguish diagnosis from simply accepting the reporter's claim.
acceptance_criteria: Ticket variants of one mechanism retain the same hidden ground truth.
Healthy scenarios inject no fault and unnecessary repairs lose credit.
The diagnostic agent cannot access evaluator ground truth, injection metadata or recovery journals.
Report healthy false positives separately from exact RCA accuracy.

stories.title: Recover safely from failed operations
stories.story: As a lab operator, I want failures and interrupted operations to retain targeted recovery information so that another evaluation cannot run against an uncertain environment.
acceptance_criteria: Record mutation intent before executing a fault, including partially applied failures.
Attempt all owned repairs and retain pending entries if repair or baseline verification fails.
Reject concurrent or duplicate mutations and automatic runs while recovery is pending.
Only the selected lab and owned fault components are modified; secrets are redacted from operator logs.
tests: dashboard_delivery.cjs: partial compound injection blocks benchmark until targeted recovery

stories.title: Follow execution progress and errors
stories.story: As a researcher, I want clear running, completed and failed states with progress and logs so that I can understand what happened during an evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: Display completed/total attempts and preserve error messages.
Disable conflicting controls while work is in progress.
Load the corresponding saved report after completion, without relabeling old results when the next configuration changes.

stories.title: Inspect traceable saved results
stories.story: As a researcher, I want saved JSON results and readable summaries with configuration, status and per-case scores so that an evaluation can be audited and compared later.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve per-run configuration, score components, errors and restoration status.
Keep different models and execution configurations separate in comparisons.
Saved report retrieval returns the original data; corrupt reports cannot break the report list.
A dedicated browser download/export control is future scope unless separately implemented; JSON files and the report API are the current handover artifacts.

stories.title: Install and operate the delivered system
stories.story: As the receiving client, I want source code, environment prerequisites, operating instructions, limitations and test evidence so that I can take ownership of the deliverable.
acceptance_criteria: Provide source revision information, dependencies, startup and recovery instructions, support matrix and evidence paths.
Identify required client infrastructure and credential setup without including secrets.
A client or independent team member follows the guide in the intended environment; record the result before claiming deployment acceptance.
tests: manual: independent installation checklist and client acceptance meeting

stories.title: Operate the interface on common screen sizes
stories.story: As a user, I want the main selection controls to work with a keyboard and on a small screen so that I can configure an experiment without layout barriers.
acceptance_criteria: The tested desktop and mobile viewports have usable selection controls and no horizontal page overflow.
Keyboard selection updates the same underlying topology/fault values as pointer selection.
State the tested browser and dimensions; do not claim comprehensive accessibility conformance from these checks.
tests: dashboard_delivery.cjs: mobile form remains usable without horizontal page overflow
